normalization: svg-norm/1: see parity-plan/VISUAL-PARITY.md §4. Strip BOM, XML declaration, DOCTYPE, comments, <title>/<desc>/<metadata> and whitespace-only text; collapse whitespace in attribute values; paint attributes (fill, stroke, color, stop-color, flood-color, lighting-color) other than none/transparent/url(...) become currentColor; drop root width, height, class, style, role, focusable, version, id, xmlns:xlink, xml:space, aria-* and data-*; sort attributes by name; serialize with no whitespace between tags and <x/> for empty elements; sha256 of the UTF-8 result.
canonicalRule: The canonical glyph is the AppFlowy glyph whose shape matches Notion's reference images (scratchpad/notion-ui); among equal matches, one already present in both repos; otherwise the web asset. Notion SVG paths are never copied into either repo.
desktopNaming: A desktop target that does not exist yet is a byte copy of the canonical file named dashboard_<name>.svg in resources/flowy_icons/16x/, so only dashboard chrome changes; app-wide assets (scope app-wide) overwrite the existing desktop asset instead (OD-3).
probe: The icons probe fails an icon until web.target and desktop.target both hash to canonical.sha256 (a null canonical fails). The status decides whether that failure blocks: pending reports it, enforced fails the build, waived skips it with a reason.

statusValues.enforced: blocking; set at the close of the icon wave
statusValues.waived: not checked; needs a waiver reason
